summary: Full backend + frontend regression for the new Live Rental Map feature. Backend pytest: 27/28 passed. The one failure (TestEquipment.test_list_seeded — asserting SB-001 seed) is a PRE-EXISTING seed-data mismatch flagged in iteration_2/3 and unrelated to this iteration. Added 5 new backend tests under TestRentalLocation covering: (a) POST /api/rentals without lat/lng returns 201 with lat=null,lng=null; (b) POST /api/rentals with lat/lng persists and appears in GET /api/rentals; (c) PATCH /api/rentals/{id}/location updates coordinates and returns full Rental; (d) unknown id returns 404; (e) unauthenticated PATCH returns 401. All 5 pass. Frontend (390x844 web preview) verified end-to-end: login works with testIDs login-email-input/login-password-input/login-submit-button; Dashboard shows 'Map' as the first Quick Action tile (action-map); Map screen loads with graceful web fallback ('Map available on device') because react-native-maps is native-only — no native-only import errors in web bundle. Rentals list shows 'No location' text and 'Set location' outline button on unpinned rentals and lat/lng badge on pinned. Location picker modal (loc-lat-input/loc-lng-input/loc-save-btn) accepts numeric coords and PATCHes /rentals/{id}/location. New Rental modal Job-site-location card renders both 'Pick on map' (draft-pick-map) and 'Geocode address' (draft-geocode) buttons. After saving coords on one rental, the Map screen fallback correctly listed 1 pin (Dedman @ 44.978,-93.265) and tapping it opened the bottom sheet with customer/job site/coords/status pill/Equipment on site rows (4 SKUs shown with 'on site' remaining count) + Open-in-Maps and Delivery-PDF buttons (sheet-open-maps, sheet-pdf). More menu order verified: [more-map, more-rentals, more-bookings, more-maintenance, more-vendors, more-site-admin] — 'Rental Map' is first as required. No red-screen or bundler errors observed; two carried-over console warnings only (expo-notifications push token listener on web + props.pointerEvents deprecation from a 3rd-party RN dep) — both non-blocking and pre-existing.

minor.issue: Pre-existing seed-SKU assertion (SB-001) doesn't match current seed (SB-2001). Not this iteration; flagged again for main agent to align test or seed.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning on web: '[expo-notifications] Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web'. Non-blocking; behaves correctly on native builds. Reference: frontend/app/(app)/(tabs)/index.tsx push registration effect.
Console warning 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' emitted from a 3rd-party RN dependency. Non-blocking, carried over from iteration_2/3.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend PATCH /api/rentals/{id}/location correctly requires foreman+ via require_role(Role.foreman); returns full Rental model and 404 on unknown id.
Rental & RentalCreate models expose lat/lng as Optional[float] with defaults None — POST without them succeeds and returns nulls as intended.

Frontend MapCanvas.web.tsx is a proper platform-specific stub so Metro's web bundler never resolves react-native-maps; verified no 'Importing native-only module' error at runtime. Uses LocationPicker modal with manual coord entry, which matches the agent-note contract for web.
map.tsx pin filtering excludes returned rentals (r.status !== 'returned') — reasonable default; confirm with product if returned rentals should also appear (e.g., historical view).
rentals.tsx correctly PATCHes /rentals/{id}/location with JSON body and reloads the list on save; saveLocation swallows response body but re-fetches, which is fine.
Bottom sheet in map.tsx dismisses on backdrop tap and stops propagation on inner TouchableOpacity — good UX; sheet items render 'remaining' (qty - returned_qty) which is the correct 'on site' count.
